item.title: Google Chrome doesn't use enough RAM, so it will soon launch in the foreground when you boot up your Windows 11 PC
item.description: A new toggle in Chrom allows the browser to launch immediately at startup. The feature is in testing now in the Canary Channel.

item.title: Epic CEO Tim Sweeney takes aim at one of Valve's Steam policies as that massive UK lawsuit looms — "This is the practice courts found illegal"
item.description: Epic Games founder and CEO Tim Sweeney argues that the way Valve handles in-game microtransactions for Steam games is "unlawful."

item.title: WWE 2K26 is finally revealed in full — Here's details on its release date, new match types, new features, and more
item.description: WWE and 2K Games have finally revealed WWE 2K26. Here's everything they announced, as well as information we acquired regarding its gameplay, release date, and more.

item.title: The Xbox Ally, with its 1080p, 120Hz display and comfy grips, is putting the Steam Deck on notice — and it's now just below $490 instead of $599
item.description: It's the end of January, but we've found a major discount to close it out in style for portable handheld gaming users. The critically-acclaimed Xbox Ally, whose performance and hardware is on par with the iconic Steam Deck, is now on sale with a 18% discount.

item.title: NVIDIA releases driver update for Maxwell and Pascal GPUs — it focuses only on security fixes, but it's still crucial for the older cards
item.description: Maxwell, Pascal, and Volta GPUs no longer receive Game Ready Driver updates, but that doesn't mean NVIDIA is ignoring them. If you have an older card, I recommend you grab this security update targeting five vulnerabilities.

item.title: Crimson Desert devs working "to make the game run as good as it possibly can" ahead of its release date — the promising open-world RPG may even rival GTA 6
item.description: Ahead of Crimson Desert's scheduled launch this March, the team at Pearl Abyss says it's in the "optimization phase" of the game's development.

item.title: Orico's straightforward Thunderbolt 5 SSD enclosure proves they'll only get more popular as storage prices rise
item.description: SSD enclosures aren't a new idea, but those with Thunderbolt 5 performance are still fairly rare. Orico's X50 counts itself among the few products, and it's been nothing but a boon to my workflow.

item.title: Gaming stocks tank as investors panic over Google’s Genie 3 AI — but should they?
item.description: Companies like Tencent, Take-Two, and others lose billions over Google's Genie 3.0.

item.title: The entry-level CPU we believe is "masterclass of performance-per-watt efficiency" is now under $200 — it has CPU Speeds of 3.9 GHz, 6 Cores, and more
item.description: Amazon has acquired a special 34% discount for the AMD Ryzen 5 9600X, making one of the most affordable and power-efficient CPUs for PCs with RTX 4080 graphics cheaper than ever.

item.title: Weekly Windows Wrap: Microsoft finally reads the room — right as it loses $440 billion
item.description: Change is often gradual, and good choices need to be rewarded. As Microsoft begins to walk back its AI overload, we look at why these small steps matter.
